blocks.text: The Dell Latitude 5330 2-in-1 combines premium performance with versatile flexibility, making it ideal for business professionals, creatives, and power users. Featuring a 12th Gen Intel Core i7 processor, 32GB RAM, and a fast 512GB SSD, this convertible laptop adapts to your workflow—use it as a traditional laptop, tent, stand, or tablet with responsive touch controls.

items: ✔ 2-in-1 Convertible Design – This Dell Latitude 5330 notebook is perfect for presentations, note-taking, or media consumption in any mode.And weight just 2.98lbs, it's lightweight for professionals on the go.

✔ Powerful 12th Gen Intel Core i7-1265U (10-Core, up to 4.8GHz Turbo Boost) – This Dell Latitude laptop computer delivers elite performance for demanding tasks, multitasking, and business applications.

✔ 32GB DDR4 RAM – Ensures smooth operation with multiple apps, virtual machines, and intensive workloads.Ultra-Fast 512GB SSD – Provides quick boot times, rapid file access, and ample storage for documents, media, and software.
✔ 13.3" FHD (1920x1080) Touchscreen Display – Vibrant visuals with 360° hinge for laptop, tent, stand, or tablet mode. Supports active pen (sold separately) for precise input.
✔ Windows 11 Pro (64-bit) Preinstalled – Enhanced security, productivity features, and seamless Microsoft 365 integration.
